## Composition objects

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [Confirmation dialog object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--confirmation-dialog-object.md) | Provides a dialog that adds a confirmation step to interactive elements. |
| [Conversation filter object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--conversation-filter-object.md) | Provides a way to filter the list of options in conversation selector menus. |
| [Dispatch action configuration object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--dispatch-action-configuration-object.md) | Defines when a plain-text input element will return a `block_actions` interaction payload. |

| [Option object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--option-object.md) | Represents a single item in a number of item selection elements. |
| [Option group object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--option-group-object.md) | Used to group option objects in select menus. |
| [Text object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--text-object.md) | Defines text for many different blocks and elements. |
| [Trigger object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--trigger-object.md) | Defines an object containing trigger information. |
| [Workflow object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--workflow-object.md) | Defines an object containing workflow information. |
| [Slack file object](slack://skills/slack-blockkit-ui/schemas/composition-objects--slack-file-object.md) | Defines an object containing Slack file information to be used in an image block or image element. |
